name: deep-opening-and-desperado
about: v0.202.0 bundle 9: 26RBS02-079 Deep Opening Hole (on the opposing turn, a Green Spirit depleted by an opposing effect puts a Void core on one of your Spirits; its LV2 puts a Void core into your Trash when your Spirits are summoned with Legacy) and 26RBS03-X06 Desperado (When Summoned: one core each from three Spirits you or the opponent controls to the Reserve, and a depletion puts a Void core on it; When Attacks: an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit sends cores until one remains).
